stories.title: Family Affair
stories.detail: one house, two contenders - Kylie and John Barac both in the mix

stories.title: Away-Day Raid
stories.detail: Tumut GC making the trip count - 2nd on the board

stories.title: Welcome to WWCC
stories.detail: Adam Elsley (Wagga City GC) - welcome to WWCC. We hope you enjoy the course and the hospitality.

stories.title: The Nightmare Hole
stories.detail: Triple bogey on hole 2 - the scorecard just copped a beating

stories.title: A Very Thorough Hole
stories.detail: +4 on hole 2 - a comprehensive, detailed, expensive visit to that part of the course

stories.title: Four and Forgotten
stories.detail: Quadruple bogey on hole 3 - the committee has been informed and they are also confused

stories.title: Three Over, Moving On
stories.detail: +3 on hole 4 - a moment of golf we shall never speak of again

stories.title: Caught at the Post
stories.detail: Led most of the day, run down to 27th at the death

stories.title: Slipping Away
stories.detail: Jason Thomson was 7th, sits 18th - a Collingwood fade: close enough to hurt

stories.title: Wooden Spoon Watch
stories.detail: Jenny Hart last today - Essendon finished 2 and 21, one bad day is nothing
